tasks.label: 1. Fetch WebView2 SDK (one-time)
tasks.detail: Downloads nuget.exe if needed, then fetches the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 SDK into packages\. Run this once before the first CMake configure -- CMakeLists.txt will fail with a clear message if you skip it.
args: if (Test-Path 'packages\Microsoft.Web.WebView2\build\native\include\WebView2.h') { Write-Host 'Already fetched, skipping.'; exit 0 }; if (-not (Test-Path 'nuget.exe')) { Write-Host 'Downloading nuget.exe...'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://dist.nuget.org/win-x86-commandline/latest/nuget.exe -OutFile nuget.exe }; .\nuget.exe install Microsoft.Web.WebView2 -OutputDirectory packages -ExcludeVersion -NonInteractive

tasks.label: 2. CMake Configure
tasks.detail: Equivalent to: cmake -S . -B build -A x64. Prefer using the CMake Tools extension's own Configure command/status-bar button instead if you have it installed -- this task is here for people using tasks/terminal only.

tasks.label: 4. CMake Install (into dist\OfficePanel)
tasks.detail: Equivalent to: cmake --install build --config Release --prefix dist\OfficePanel

tasks.label: Full build (fetch SDK + configure + build + install)
tasks.detail: Runs all four steps above in order via their own chained dependsOn -- this is the one task most people want, and Ctrl+Shift+B runs it by default.
